component.name: Ultimate Linux Doom Builder
component.summary: Map editor for GZDoom and UZDoom

description.p: Ultimate Linux Doom Builder (ULDB) is an unofficial, native Linux fork of Ultimate Doom Builder. It edits maps for GZDoom and UZDoom: UDMF maps, ZDoom-style ACS and BCS scripts, 3D floors, slopes and dynamic lights, in 2D and 3D modes.
ULDB runs on .NET and Avalonia instead of Mono and WinForms. It aims to keep the editor familiar to Ultimate Doom Builder users. Other Doom engines and map formats are hidden.

The Linux port is AI-coded: it is developed with AI assistance (Claude by Anthropic). ULDB is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Ultimate Doom Builder team. Please report problems to the ULDB project, not to upstream.
Texture browser, Map Options, Preferences and a new script editor are in. Toast notifications and a round of bug fixes.
Development snapshot. The editor shell, the main edit windows and the 2D and 3D modes are being ported. Not ready for real mapping work yet.
